description: Minimum required fields for the OSE SharedReport interface. Removing any field from top_level_fields, sponsor_displays_fields, or campaign_summary_fields MUST be accompanied by removing it here and bumping the version — that makes the break visible in a diff rather than silent. Adding new fields is always safe (additive). This snapshot is the output-side complement to public-events.snapshot.json: the public API snapshot protects what consumers GET from /api/v2/events; this snapshot protects what enterprise sponsors and organizers see in /api/v2/events/:id/shared-report.
